thread:
alex_k: FYI spike in retries for svc/gpu-inference across us-west-2 around 09:12 UTC. Clients report 502/504 and exponential retries.
priya_s: Seeing it on grafana too — 90th latency up and a bunch of kube-proxy drop counters. Link: https://grafana.company/dashboard/xyz
mike_r: Any packet-loss on the nodes? run: `kubectl get endpoints gpu-inference -o wide` and `ipvsadm -ln --stats` on affected nodes
ellen_ops: pasted outputs:
```
# kubectl get endpoints gpu-inference -o wide
NAME           ENDPOINTS                        AGE
gpu-inference  10.2.3.4:8000,10.2.8.7:8000     2d
```
and on node-12 `ipvsadm -Ln`:
```
TCP 10.3.0.10:8000 rr
  -> 10.2.3.4:8000            Masq    1      0  0
  -> 10.2.8.7:8000            Masq    1      0  47
```
mike_r: look at conncounts: node-12 shows almost all connections to 10.2.8.7, node-14 is opposite. Something off with hash distribution.
priya_s: also found MTU mismatch — host nic mtu 9000 but overlay 1500 on some nodes, causing fragmentation for RDMA traffic. `ethtool -i` shows rdma0 mtu 9000 on node-14, overlay is 1500
alex_k: Could be two separate issues: ipvs endpoint ordering inconsistency + MTU causing packet loss -> client retries. Which nodes show packet-drop? `ss -s` shows retransmits on node-14.
mike_r: I rolled kube-proxy on node-12 and node-14 around 09:25. Retries dropped by ~40% for 20m then climbed back.
ellen_ops: Logs show kube-proxy v1.24.0 using ipvs hash-mode 'destination' - kernel 5.15.60 seems to have known skew when endpoint lists differ across nodes.
priya_s: Proposed mitigations: 1) roll kube-proxy to 1.25.x that has patch for ipvs ordering; 2) enable endpointSliceThrottling and increase syncPeriod; 3) ensure MTU uniformity and disable RDMA across overlay or align MTU; 4) add healthcheck-fallback in service to prefer local endpoints when latency > X
alex_k: short-term: apply a smaller kube-proxy restart window across the pool every 5m to re-sync? risky. Better: cordon nodes with bad MTU and migrate pods.
mike_r: filed a ticket infra-4293 with node dump and ipvs tables. Also created runbook:
```
- check ipvsadm -Ln
- kubectl get endpoints -o wide
- ethtool eth0
- ip link show
- restart kube-proxy
```
deploy-bot: Deployment kube-proxy/1.25.2 rolled to 3 nodes (ci) at 10:02 UTC :white_check_mark:
ellen_ops: Next: schedule kube-proxy upgrade for us-west-2 staging, coordinate with oncall to monitor. I'll also open a followup for MTU remediation.
alex_k: Thanks. If we see this again, escalate to networking team and we'll consider making service sessionAffinity=ClientIP as workaround.
priya_s: thx, will update infra-4293 with MTU diff and grafana screenshots :thumbsup:
